notes: Model pilot (sonnet arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole reads the held pole bonsai1/L22/N5705+ (zeroing the anchor removes 0.99 of this pole's activation), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Sonnet 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: McGinn scored 1.02 and Craigievar 0.55 in probes, but MacLeod (0.06) and Walter Scott (0.02) did not, so the label is Mc- surnames and Gaelic place pieces rather than anything Scottish. Quiet items use English, Irish and Welsh names as the neighbouring concept.
